definitions.gloss: abolition; eradication; doing away with entirely
definitions.explanation: Completely abolishing or wiping out something undesirable so that it ceases to exist. Often used of weapons, discrimination, and harmful customs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廃絶|はいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: To call for the abolition of nuclear weapons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廃絶|はいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A movement aiming to eradicate discrimination spread.

examples.japanese: {被爆|ひばく}{国|こく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{核兵器|かくへいき}→核兵器：13126_kakuheiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{廃絶|はいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{求|もと}め→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: As a country that suffered atomic bombing, Japan continues to call on the world to abolish nuclear weapons.

notes:
Compound of {廃|はい} (abolish, discard) + {絶|ぜつ} (sever, exterminate). A strong word implying total elimination, not mere reduction. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a transitive verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧{廃絶|はいぜつ}: abolition of nuclear weapons
- {廃絶|はいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to call for abolition
- {廃絶|はいぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim at eradication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧: abolition (of a system or rule) — repealing laws, institutions, or services
- ⟦{撲滅|ぼくめつ}→撲滅：19614_bokumetsu⟧: eradication; stamping out — campaigning to wipe out crime, disease, or evils
